resources.string: Keep elbows at ~45 degrees to your torso and wrists stacked vertically.
Inhale deep lowering down, exhale powerfully pressing up.
Bouncing the bar off your chest or lifting hips off the bench.

string-array.name: ex_g1_1_steps
string-array.item: Lie flat on the bench and plant your feet firmly on the floor.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower the bar under control to your mid-lower chest.
Press the bar up strongly while squeezing your chest.

resources.string: Don\'t clang dumbbells together at the top—keep tension constant.
Setting the bench steeper than 45° and shifting work to front delts.

string-array.name: ex_g1_2_steps
string-array.item: Set the bench to a 30-degree incline.
Press dumbbells up above your shoulders.
Lower with control by opening elbows out to upper chest level.
Drive back up feeling upper chest contraction at the top.

resources.string: Avoid excessively arching your lower back; keep ribs stacked down.
Pressing the dumbbells far forward in front of your face.

string-array.name: ex_g1_3_steps
string-array.item: Sit upright with your core braced.
Hold dumbbells at ear level with palms facing forward.
Press smoothly overhead without locking elbows hard.
Lower slowly back to ear height.

resources.string: Only the elbow joint moves—shoulders stay pinned.
Leaning forward over the rope using bodyweight.

string-array.name: ex_g1_4_steps
string-array.item: Grip the rope attachment at chest height.
Lock your elbows tight to your ribs.
Extend forearms fully down and flare the rope ends apart.
Return under control without letting elbows drift.

resources.string: Pull through your elbows rather than your hands.
Exhale pulling down, inhale releasing up.
Swinging torso far backward for momentum.

string-array.name: ex_g2_1_steps
string-array.item: Grip the bar wide and lock knees under the thigh pad.
Lift your chest slightly upward.
Pull elbows down and back, bringing the bar to upper chest.
Extend arms overhead smoothly under control.

resources.string: Keep shoulders depressed away from your ears.
Exhale as you pull toward you.

string-array.name: ex_g2_2_steps
string-array.item: Brace feet on platform with a slight knee bend.
Keep spine tall and row handle to your midsection.
Squeeze shoulder blades together for 1 second.
Extend forward under control.

resources.string: Essential protective exercise for upright posture.
Exhale as you pull toward your face.
Loading too heavy and leaning back with lower back.

string-array.name: ex_g2_3_steps
string-array.item: Set rope pulley at eye height.
Pull rope toward forehead while flaring elbows wide.
Externally rotate fists back at peak to squeeze rear delts.
Return smoothly under control.

resources.string: Keep wrists neutral without bending them inward.
Swinging your lower back to heave the bar.

string-array.name: ex_g2_4_steps
string-array.item: Grip the EZ-bar at shoulder width.
Pin elbows steadily at your sides.
Curl up to shoulder height and squeeze for 1 second.
Lower slowly over 3 full seconds.

resources.string: Track knees over toes without caving inward.
Lifting heels off the ground or rounding the lower back.

string-array.name: ex_g3_1_steps
string-array.item: Rest bar across upper traps with feet shoulder-width apart.
Inhale and brace your core tightly.
Sit hips back and down until thighs reach parallel.
Drive powerfully through your heels to stand.

resources.string: This is a hip hinge—not a waist bend.
Inhale lowering down, exhale driving hips forward.
Letting the bar drift away from your legs and rounding your back.

string-array.name: ex_g3_2_steps
string-array.item: Hold bar at hips with softly unlocked knees.
With a flat back, push hips back while gliding the bar along your legs.
Once hamstrings stretch deeply, squeeze glutes forward to stand.

resources.string: Never lower so deep that your glutes curl off the pad.
Snapping knees into full lockout at the top.

string-array.name: ex_g3_3_steps
string-array.item: Keep lower back and glutes pressed flat against the seat.
Place feet shoulder-width on the sled.
Unlock safeties and bring knees smoothly toward chest.
Press back without locking knees stiffly.

resources.string: Bouncing too quickly on the Achilles tendon.

string-array.name: ex_g3_4_steps
string-array.item: Stand with balls of your feet on a step edge.
Stretch heels all the way down slowly.
Drive onto tiptoes to full height and pause 1 second.

resources.string: Keep your chest facing forward, don\'t tip over.
Holding the weight far out away from your chest.

string-array.name: ex_g4_1_steps
string-array.item: Hold one dumbbell vertically against your upper chest.
Squat down with an upright torso.
When elbows touch inside knees, drive back up cleanly.

resources.string: Don\'t roll shoulders forward; keep chest proud.
Dropping the weight stack so plates slam.

string-array.name: ex_g4_2_steps
string-array.item: Adjust seat so handles line up with mid-chest.
Press back into pad and push handles forward.
Control return smoothly to start.

resources.string: Don\'t shrug shoulders up toward your neck.

string-array.name: ex_g4_3_steps
string-array.item: Rest chest lightly against the pad and grab handles.
Pull elbows straight back squeezing upper back.
Extend forward under control.

resources.string: In through nose, out through mouth steadily.
Piking hips high or sagging the lower back.

string-array.name: ex_g4_4_steps
string-array.item: Set up on forearms like a push-up.
Form one straight line from head to heels.
Brace abs and glutes tightly until time is up.

resources.string: A 1-second pause at the bottom boosts strength.
Flaring elbows straight out at 90 degrees.

string-array.name: ex_g5_1_steps
string-array.item: Kick dumbbells smoothly to chest level using knees.
Press overhead and lower with control.

resources.string: Pull strictly with your back without twisting your torso.
Rowing the dumbbell straight up toward your shoulder.

string-array.name: ex_g5_2_steps
string-array.item: Support one hand and knee on a bench with flat back.
Row the dumbbell smoothly toward your hip pocket.

resources.string: Lead slightly with your pinky side up.
Hopping and swinging arms with momentum.

string-array.name: ex_g5_3_steps
string-array.item: Hold dumbbells at sides with soft elbows.
Raise arms out to the sides up to shoulder level.

resources.string: Fastest grip variation for overall arm thickness.

string-array.name: ex_g5_4_steps
string-array.item: Hold dumbbells with palms facing each other.
Keep elbows pinned and curl cleanly.

resources.string: Engages front and lateral delts in one sweep.

string-array.name: ex_g6_1_steps
string-array.item: Start with palms facing your face in front of shoulders.
Rotate wrists outward as you press overhead.
Reverse smoothly back to start.

resources.string: Keep elbows fixed slightly behind your torso.
Swinging elbows forward on the lift.

string-array.name: ex_g6_2_steps
string-array.item: Lean back on a 45-degree incline bench.
Let arms hang down freely and curl from the elbows.

resources.string: Don\'t let elbows flare wide outward.
Using excessive weight and straining elbows.

string-array.name: ex_g6_3_steps
string-array.item: Lie flat holding EZ-bar vertical over your eyes.
Bend only at elbows to lower bar behind forehead, then extend.

resources.string: Keeps constant tension even at the very bottom.
Leaning torso sideways to swing up.

string-array.name: ex_g6_4_steps
string-array.item: Stand sideways and hold low pulley across front of body.
Raise smoothly out to shoulder height.
